notes.frame: each piece in its joint's frame: x to the fighter's right, y forward, z up, metres, at the standard size (the body node's scale, the design's size, makes the whole fighter bigger or smaller); triangles anticlockwise seen from outside
notes.layout: where each piece goes: fight_models.layout(body, model) in the window's code (BeatEmUp/fight_models.py), mirrored by the page: body is the design's body ("robot", or anything else is built as a human, as the lower tiers do), model a boss's name or null
notes.joints: fight_gfx.FighterVisual's skeleton (the page's fight.js JOINTS): hips at HIP_H 0.92 over the feet (turned by the poses), waist 0.1 over the hips, neck 0.5 over the waist, shoulders (ls, rs) at x -/+ (0.25 robot, 0.2 human; 0.04 more for a boss), y 0, z 0.44 on the waist, elbows (le, re) 0.29 down the shoulders' -z, hips' joints (lh, rh) at x -/+ 0.11 on the hips, knees (lk, rk) 0.42 down, ankles (la, ra) 0.42 down; the fists are part of the forearms' pieces (0.26 down le and re)
notes.roles: colour null: the design's colour; "trim", "skin": the style's; "hair": the fighter's hair colour (from its name, fight_gfx.FighterVisual.hair_colour); "pants": the design's colour times 0.55; "shade": times 0.78; "lips": the skin times (0.85, 0.62, 0.6); emission "lights": the style's lights colour (screen colour) times 5
